creator: Alexander Terp
description:
docs/mip/0008-panes-across-machines.md, 531 lines: spanning tabs. Questions A to C are already in Fencil (spanning-tab-unreachable-machine, spanning-tab-departed-machine, split-onto-machine-menu). Question D, that muster window --json dropped regions[], is not: the MIP says amterp left it to an agent, so level none. Also record the Decision's tree-ownership rules (one tree per tab on every machine holding part of it, the window merging copies).

How to migrate, the same for every MIP (parent a_2xhSx0Jzq):

- One Fencil decision per question the MIP settles: each numbered part of its Decision, each "Decisions for amterp" question, and each addendum or History entry that changed an answer. Leave out implementation details nobody weighed (`fencil` skill, record-consequential-only). Run `fencil search` first; a question already in Fencil gets a revision, not a duplicate.
- Put the rejected alternatives from Alternatives Considered in the decision's why, and cite the MIP by its repo path as `source`.
- Set each level by `fencil rules`. The MIP's status says little: several Draft MIPs are built. An owner quote in the MIP, its kan card or a commit message supports an owner level; "amterp left the choice to an agent" supports `none`. When unsure, the lower level. Add `review = "<reason>"` where an owner should check the reading.
- Give each decision the `paths` of the code it governs, so `fencil search --path` finds it.
- An Open Question with no answer becomes an open decision (no answer), so `fencil ask` lists it.
- Add a History line to the MIP naming the decisions it became. Do not delete or rewrite the MIP.

Done when `fencil check` passes and `fencil search` finds each decision by the terms a later change to that code would use.
title: Migrate MIP-8 (panes from any machine anywhere in a tab) into Fencil
